relationships.subject: Fgr
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of Fgr reduced SIRT1 expression, and knockdown of Fgr increased SIRT1 protein levels

relationships.subject: Fgr
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrated that Fgr could phosphorylate mouse SIRT1

relationships.subject: TL02-59
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-6 and TNF-α expression was elevated in septic mice compared with the sham group, while Fgr inhibitor administration significantly reversed these increases

key_findings: CLP sepsis increased hippocampal neuronal Fgr; the Fgr inhibitor TL02-59 improved survival, cognition, and reduced neuroinflammation.
Fgr interacts with and suppresses SIRT1; SIRT1/PGC-1α mediates the protective effect.
